title: A field extension induces a flat morphism of spectra
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. The structure morphism $\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism].
